name: Moekan
source:
The title follows Takahiro, an enigmatic man served unquestioningly by five beautiful maids with equally mysterious pasts tied to his. Primarily set within a secluded mansion estate, the story is a combination of humor, romance, and surprisingly dark violence; all revealing the exact nature of their association and shared questionable future. The game features three distinct styles of high quality artwork: a tradition style for storytelling, a super-deformed style for comedic events, and a blood red gothic style for the darker moments.

[From [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1633]AniDB[/url]]

An anarchistic country that is said to dominate the world exists on a vast island known as Moekko Island. This is where the final works of AC Company's android combat maids (resembling beautiful young girls) are done, also where these maids get there communication training. A new maid is to come to the island to be trained, Rinia, she is a young looking girl, who has lost her all of her memories, she tries very hard to impress the owner at Moekko island, but just ends up making a lot of trouble around the mansion. Takahiro, the owner of Moekko island, a depressive young man who has also lost his memories is seen as a very unhappy person who thinks Rinia will only be trouble around the mansion. As time passes, Takahiro slowly grows attached to Rinia's attempted ways of helping and so starts a beautiful relationship among the quiet island.

[From [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2652]ANN[/url]]
translation:
本作讲述神秘男子贵广的故事。五名拥有同样神秘过往的美丽女仆无条件服侍着他，她们的经历都与贵广紧密相连。故事主要发生在一座与世隔绝的宅邸庄园，将幽默、爱情与出人意料的黑暗暴力融为一体，逐渐揭示众人关系的本质，以及充满疑问的共同未来。游戏采用三种风格鲜明的高质量画面：讲述故事时的传统风格、喜剧事件中的Q版风格，以及黑暗场景里的血红哥特风格。

[摘自[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1633]AniDB[/url]]

据说统治世界的无政府国家坐落在广阔的萌子岛上。这里是AC公司制造仿美少女战斗女仆仿生人的最后工序所在地，也是她们接受交流训练的地方。一名叫莉妮娅的新女仆来到岛上受训。她外表年幼，失去了全部记忆，十分努力地想给岛主留下好印象，却只是在宅邸里不断制造麻烦。萌子岛的主人贵广是个同样失忆、郁郁寡欢的年轻人，认定莉妮娅只会给宅邸添乱。随着时间流逝，他逐渐被她努力帮助他人的举动打动，一段美好的感情也在宁静岛屿上萌芽。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=2652]ANN[/url]]
